title: Mirabel and the Hollow
author: Emrys Eriksen
blurb: Wren Okafor, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
